## Summary

- What changed?
- Why is this the smallest defensible change?

## Verification

- [ ] Hash-locked install succeeds.
- [ ] Ruff format/lint and strict mypy pass.
- [ ] Tests and the 80% line-coverage minimum pass.
- [ ] Alembic upgrade and drift check pass.
- [ ] Dependency audit was reviewed.
- [ ] Container/Compose checks ran, or the exact blocker is documented.

## Safety and claims

- [ ] No secret, token, confidential file, or employer material is included.
- [ ] Only synthetic test data is used.
- [ ] README, limitations, and evidence claims match the executed checks.
